collection.name: The Odyssey
collection.description: Introducing The Odyssey by the Yokai Avengers, the first fully on-chain graphic novel (Manga) in history. This innovative and exclusive collection is limited to a total supply of 999, with each book featuring a front and back cover and 38 pages of carefully crafted, high-quality art based on Odin’s Odyssey. The manga comes with five different covers and rarities inscribed on rare sats! This is not just a collection; it’s mixing high-quality art with tech innovation, adding to the Ordinals.
